catches: Binance.com does not serve US residents (the official announcement warns 'products and services may not be available in your region'); the catalog's 'US resident' eligibility is wrong.
Current September 2026 campaign is new-users-only: registered after September 1, 2026 08:00 (UTC+8), identity-verified, all quiz answers correct.
Reward is 0.00001 BTC in a token voucher (~$1 at current prices), not $2-$10 in crypto per module.
Rewards are limited to the first 5,000 new users each month, first-come-first-served; one reward per user per period.
Token vouchers expire 14 days after distribution (per official FAQ); rewards distributed within 48 hours of passing the quiz.
Crypto value fluctuates — 0.00001 BTC's dollar value moves with the market.

steps: Create a Binance account at binance.com (note: Binance.com does not serve US residents) and complete identity verification.
Go to the Binance Academy Bitcoin 'Learn & Earn' quiz page — the September 2026 campaign is for users who registered after September 1, 2026 08:00 (UTC+8).
Work through the Bitcoin course material and answer every quiz question correctly.
Wait for the 0.00001 BTC token voucher to be distributed to your Rewards Hub (within 48 hours of passing).
Redeem the token voucher from Account → Rewards Hub BEFORE it expires (vouchers are valid 14 days from distribution).
timing: Token voucher distributed within 48 hours of passing the quiz; voucher valid 14 days from distribution; redeem to spot within the window.
